# National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH)

> NCCIH is the NIH's primary agency for scientific research on complementary and integrative health approaches, providing evidence-based information to consumers and healthcare professionals.

NCCIH conducts and funds rigorous research on complementary health practices including pain management, natural products, and whole-person health approaches. The center serves both the public and healthcare providers with authoritative, scientifically-grounded information on dietary supplements, herbal medicines, and integrative health strategies.

## Key Topics

## Consumer Health Information

- [Health Info Home](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health): Hub for complementary health information, clinical trials, and consumer resources.
- [Topics A-Z](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/atoz): A-Z directory of complementary health topics, herbal supplements, and conditions.
- [Safety Information](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/safety): Safety guidelines for complementary health products, drug interactions, and supplements.
- [What Is Complementary, Alternative, or Integrative Health?](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/complementary-alternative-or-integrative-health-whats-in-a-name): Definitions and introduction to complementary, alternative, and integrative health.
- [Know the Science](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/know-science): Tools to understand health research and make informed decisions about complementary health.
- [Tips on Complementary Health](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/tips): Tips on complementary health practices, evidence, and decision-making guidance.
- [Pain](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/pain): Pain management information and NCCIH research programs for consumers and providers.
- [Información en Español](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/espanol): Spanish-language health information on complementary medicine and dietary supplements.

## Research Programs & Divisions

- [Research Home](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research): NCCIH research overview, funding, clinical trials, and research divisions.
- [Division of Extramural Research](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/extramural): Extramural research division overseeing grants, pain research, and natural products.
- [Division of Intramural Research](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/intramural): Intramural research division conducting pain and whole-person health studies.
- [NIH Pain Research Center](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/nih-pain-research-center): Multidisciplinary pain research center studying mechanisms and nonopioid treatments.
- [Clinical Trials](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/clinicaltrials): Information on NCCIH clinical trials and volunteer recruitment opportunities.

## Research Resources & Results

- [Research Results by Date](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/research-results): Plain language summaries of NCCIH-supported and conducted studies.
- [Resources for Researchers](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/resources): Clinical research toolbox, study recruitment, and systematic review resources.
- [NCCIH Research Blog](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/blog): Blog on research developments and grant funding in complementary health.

## Professional Resources

- [Resources for Health Care Professionals](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/providers): Evidence-based resources, clinical guidelines, and CME for healthcare providers.

## Research Data & Statistics

- [Statistics on Use](https://www.nccih.nih.gov/research/statistics-on-complementary-and-integrative-health-approaches): National survey data on Americans' use of complementary and integrative health approaches.

## Site Home

- [NCCIH Homepage](https://www.nccih.nih.gov): NCCIH homepage with complementary and integrative health information and resources.
